tools.signup: Self-host or use the free cloud account; no card for the free path. Hosted limits and AI provider costs may apply.
tools.free: Open-source automation software with AI-capable pieces and a visual workflow builder, free to self-host.
tools.limits: Self-hosting requires maintenance and infrastructure. The hosted cloud has separate limits. AI model usage, integrations, and some features may need external accounts or API costs.
tools.best_for: A self-hosted alternative for small teams that want automation and AI steps under their control.

tools.name: Bardeen
tools.signup: Free account and browser extension; no card. Monthly credits are limited.
tools.free: A free monthly credit allowance for browser automations, data capture, and AI-assisted workflows that cut repetitive web tasks.
tools.limits: Credits and scheduled runs are capped, and advanced AI actions, teams, and higher volume are paid. Browser automation can break when a site changes, so verify results.
tools.best_for: Small research or prospecting chores that happen in your browser, such as collecting information from pages.

tools.name: Taskade
tools.signup: Free account; no card. AI credits and member limits apply.
tools.free: Free projects, notes, task lists, and collaborative workspaces with a limited allocation of AI actions and agents.
tools.limits: AI credits, workspace members, file storage, and advanced views are capped or paid. Test important automations before relying on them for deadlines.
tools.best_for: A lightweight project hub for a small team or solo business with occasional AI help.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Storage and AI-note limits apply, and participants must consent.
tools.free: Free AI meeting notes with automatic transcription, summaries, and search across a limited storage allowance.
tools.limits: Storage, advanced analytics, integrations, and some AI features are limited or paid. The bot joins calls and records audio; inform participants and follow workplace policy.
tools.best_for: Occasional meeting notes where the team understands how the recorder works and consents to it.

tools.name: Fathom
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Current free recording, retention, and team limits apply.
tools.free: Free meeting recording and AI summaries, with a workflow built around reviewing highlights and action items after a call.
tools.limits: Advanced team, search, and integration features are paid. Check current free-plan recording and retention conditions. Obtain consent before recording any participant.
tools.best_for: Solo founders and small teams who want summaries and follow-ups without paying per meeting.

tools.name: tl;dv
tools.signup: Free account; no card. AI-note and storage limits apply.
tools.free: Free screen and meeting recording with AI notes, timestamps, and highlights on the free plan.
tools.limits: Free AI-note counts, retention, integrations, and advanced sharing features are limited. Recording rules and participant consent vary by location and organization.
tools.best_for: Recording demos, interviews, or occasional meetings and jumping back to the exact moment discussed.

tools.name: Granola
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Meeting history and collaboration limits apply.
tools.free: A free AI meeting-notes app that combines your typed notes with audio context, without sending a bot into the meeting.
tools.limits: The free plan limits meeting history and some collaboration or sharing features. It records system/mic audio locally or in the cloud depending on platform; confirm your privacy posture.
tools.best_for: People who take terse notes during calls and want a readable summary afterward.

tools.name: Loom
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Video count, length, and AI feature limits apply.
tools.free: Free screen and camera recordings with shareable links, basic editing, and limited AI features.
tools.limits: The free plan caps video count/length and AI transcript/summary features. Longer recordings, custom branding, and team controls are paid.
tools.best_for: Quick walkthroughs and asynchronous updates without scheduling a meeting.

tools.name: Scribe
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Guide and AI-feature limits apply.
tools.free: Free automatic how-to guides generated from screen recordings, with annotated screenshots and editable steps.
tools.limits: Free guide count, AI features, branding, and sharing options are limited; paid plans add team and knowledge-base tools. Redact anything private before sharing a capture.
tools.best_for: Turning a process you just performed into a clear SOP or onboarding document.

tools.name: Khoj
tools.signup: Self-host from the official repository; no vendor account or card. A cloud sign-in is optional and separate.
tools.free: An open-source personal AI assistant that can search your notes and documents and answer questions using local or remote models.
tools.limits: Self-hosting requires setup and a model source; cloud offerings and limits can change. Retrieval quality depends on your files and indexing, and sensitive notes need protection.
tools.best_for: Building a private second brain over your own notes and documents.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Monthly AI credits and export or branding limits apply.
tools.free: Free AI-assisted presentations, documents, and webpages with a starting allowance of AI credits and editable templates.
tools.limits: Free AI credits are limited, some designs and export options are paid, and public projects may include branding. Complex decks still need thoughtful human editing.
tools.best_for: Turning an outline into a presentable first draft of slides for a workshop, pitch, or training.

tools.name: Napkin
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Visual and export limits apply.
tools.free: Free AI-assisted conversion of text into simple diagrams, flowcharts, and visual explanations for presentations and learning.
tools.limits: Free visual counts, style controls, and high-resolution exports are limited. Generated diagrams may not reflect the logic you intended, so check every relationship and label.
tools.best_for: Explaining a process or idea visually when you do not want to draw every box yourself.

tools.name: Mermaid Chart
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Diagram, AI, and privacy limits apply.
tools.free: A free editor for Mermaid text-to-diagram code, with AI assistance for turning descriptions into diagrams and live rendering.
tools.limits: Free diagram counts, AI credits, private diagrams, and collaboration features are limited. Complex diagrams may need hand-written Mermaid knowledge and careful checking.
tools.best_for: Flowcharts and technical diagrams that you want to version as plain text.

tools.name: Khanmigo
tools.signup: Khan Academy account plus teacher verification for free educator access. Students generally need a paid plan; no card for eligible teachers.
tools.free: Khan Academy's AI tutor and teaching assistant is free for verified teachers in supported regions, with tutoring and lesson-planning support.
tools.limits: Student and parent accounts generally require a paid subscription. Free teacher access depends on verification, geography, and current program availability. Tutors can make mistakes.
tools.best_for: Teachers who want Socratic-style question prompts and planning help tied to Khan Academy material.

tools.name: Duolingo
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Ads and heart or feature limits apply.
tools.free: Free language lessons in many languages, with streaks, practice exercises, stories, and some AI-powered feedback on the free plan.
tools.limits: Ads, hearts, and feature limits apply; advanced personalization, unlimited mistakes, and some AI features require Super or Max. AI feedback is not a human conversation partner.
tools.best_for: Building a daily language habit and practicing vocabulary at no cost.

tools.name: Quizlet
tools.signup: Free account; no card. AI and offline features are limited.
tools.free: Free flashcard sets, practice tests, study modes, and a limited amount of AI-assisted study help.
tools.limits: AI features, offline access, and ad removal are restricted or paid. User-created sets vary in accuracy, and AI-generated explanations need checking.
tools.best_for: Turning vocabulary or definitions into flashcards and self-testing before an exam.

tools.name: Kahoot!
tools.signup: Free account; no card. AI question generation and reports are capped.
tools.free: Free live quizzes and classroom games, with basic question creation and a limited amount of AI-assisted question generation for teachers.
tools.limits: AI question generation, advanced reports, and larger/team features are capped or paid. Teachers should review AI-generated questions for errors and bias before class.
tools.best_for: Quick review games and active recall in a classroom or study group.

tools.name: Quizizz
tools.signup: Free teacher account; no card. AI runs and advanced reports are limited.
tools.free: A free teacher plan for creating quizzes and lessons, with AI tools for question generation and some student-paced practice.
tools.limits: Free AI runs, reports, and question types are limited. Advanced tools and unlimited AI use are paid. Review every generated question before students see it.
tools.best_for: Teachers who want a browser-based quiz and practice workflow with some AI shortcuts.

tools.name: MagicSchool
tools.signup: Free educator account; no card. Monthly AI generations are limited; some tools require verification.
tools.free: A free educator plan with a collection of AI tools for lesson plans, rubrics, emails, differentiation, and classroom feedback.
tools.limits: The free plan has a limited monthly allowance of AI generations and access limits; unlimited use and some student tools are paid. Review all generated teaching material.
tools.best_for: Teachers who want a toolbox of time-saving first drafts for common classroom tasks.

tools.name: Diffit
tools.signup: Free account; no card. Monthly resource limits apply.
tools.free: Free AI help adapting texts and creating reading supports, vocabulary, and question sets at different levels.
tools.limits: Free monthly resources and some formats/features are limited. Generated adaptations need a teacher's review for accuracy, age-appropriateness, and reading level.
tools.best_for: Making a lesson reading more accessible without rewriting it from scratch.

tools.name: Brisk Teaching
tools.signup: Chrome extension with a free teacher account; no card. AI action limits and school policies apply.
tools.free: A free Chrome extension that helps teachers give feedback, adapt materials, and generate lesson resources from what is on screen.
tools.limits: Free AI actions and advanced features are limited. The extension sees page content, so avoid student records or confidential material. Review feedback before returning it.
tools.best_for: Fast feedback and lesson tweaks inside the tools a teacher already uses.

tools.name: Socratic by Google
tools.signup: Free app download; no account or card required.
tools.free: Free mobile homework help: take a photo of a question and get explanations, relevant learning resources, and step-by-step guidance.
tools.limits: The app is free, but answers can be incomplete or wrong and coverage varies by subject. It is a study aid, not a guarantee of the correct answer or a substitute for showing your work.
tools.best_for: Middle school through college students who want an explanation of a homework question.

tools.name: Photomath
tools.signup: Free app download; no card. Some solutions and features require an upgrade.
tools.free: Free math scanning and step-by-step explanations for many core arithmetic, algebra, and other problems.
tools.limits: Some advanced problem types, solutions, and features require Plus or Max. The app may show ads. Always check the reasoning rather than copying the final answer.
tools.best_for: Getting unstuck on a math problem and seeing one possible route to the solution.

tools.name: Wolfram|Alpha
tools.signup: No account needed for basic queries; no card. Step-by-step and extended features may require Pro.
tools.free: Free computational answers, plots, unit conversions, and topic lookups across math, science, and general knowledge.
tools.limits: Step-by-step solutions, extended computation time, and some data/features require Pro. The free website still shows results, but the depth and export options are limited.
tools.best_for: Checking calculations and exploring math or science with a reliable computational engine.

tools.name: Eduaide.ai
tools.signup: Free teacher account; no card. Credits and tool counts are limited.
tools.free: A free teacher plan with AI tools for lesson plans, questions, activities, and feedback, plus a starter allowance of generations.
tools.limits: Free credits and tools are limited; higher volume, collaboration, and advanced generators are paid. Generated educational content must be checked for accuracy and fit.
tools.best_for: Teachers who want a broad menu of classroom planning helpers in one place.

tools.name: Class Companion
tools.signup: Free teacher account; no card. Assignment and feedback allowances are limited.
tools.free: A free teacher plan for AI-assisted writing assignments and feedback, with a student-friendly practice workflow.
tools.limits: Free assignment and feedback allowances are limited; school and advanced plans are paid. AI feedback can miss context, and students should receive teacher oversight.
tools.best_for: Teachers who want students to practice short written responses with immediate formative feedback.

tools.name: Teachable Machine
tools.signup: Open the browser tool with no account or card. Uploads are processed by the browser or Google depending on the mode.
tools.free: A free Google browser tool for training simple image, sound, and pose classification models with your own examples, no coding required.
tools.limits: It is an educational tool, not a production ML platform. Quality depends on data and training choices, models can be small or biased, and uploads may be processed by Google.
tools.best_for: Hands-on lessons about how machine learning recognizes images, sounds, or poses.

tools.name: Seeing AI
tools.signup: Free App Store download; no account or card. Requires a supported iPhone or iPad.
tools.free: A free Microsoft app for iOS that narrates short text, documents, people, scenes, products, and currency to support everyday tasks.
tools.limits: Features and language support vary by device and region. Recognition can fail in poor light or complex scenes, and it should not be trusted alone for medication, navigation, or safety decisions.
tools.best_for: Reading mail, labels, and packaging or getting a quick description of a scene.

tools.name: Be My Eyes
tools.signup: Free account and app; no card. AI description fair-use limits apply.
tools.free: A free app connecting blind and low-vision users with sighted volunteers and AI descriptions of photos or live scenes.
tools.limits: AI descriptions have fair-use limits and can be wrong; volunteer availability varies. Humans may see what you share, so avoid exposing sensitive documents or banking details.
tools.best_for: Getting quick human or AI help reading a label, matching clothing, or checking a setting.

tools.name: Google Lookout
tools.signup: Free Play Store download; no card. Supported Android devices and regions only.
tools.free: A free Android app that uses the camera and AI to identify currency, read text, explore scenes, and find objects in supported regions.
tools.limits: Supported modes, devices, and languages vary. Recognition is not perfect and should not be used as the only method for navigation or safety-critical decisions.
tools.best_for: Everyday Android assistance with reading, products, and scene descriptions.

tools.name: Live Transcribe & Sound Notifications
tools.signup: Free Play Store download or built-in Android tool; no account or card.
tools.free: A free Android app and built-in accessibility tool for real-time speech captions and sound alerts such as doorbells, alarms, or a name being called.
tools.limits: Accuracy depends on language, microphone, noise, and dialect. Some features need downloads or connectivity. Do not rely on it alone for emergencies or critical instructions.
tools.best_for: Following in-person conversations and being alerted to important sounds.

tools.name: Envision AI
tools.signup: Free app and free account; no card. Premium features require a subscription.
tools.free: A free app for scanning documents, reading text, recognizing scenes, and getting AI descriptions, with a usable free allowance.
tools.limits: Free usage and advanced AI features are limited; higher volume and premium features require a subscription. Accuracy varies with image quality and content.
tools.best_for: Reading documents and exploring everyday images with a mix of on-device and AI tools.

tools.name: SuperSense
tools.signup: Free app with an optional account; no card for the free tier. Paid plans add features.
tools.free: A free AI app for blind users with modes for reading, finding objects, recognizing currency, and exploring scenes.
tools.limits: Free features and usage are limited; some capabilities require a paid plan. Recognition can miss obstacles or make unsafe guesses. Use a mobility aid and training.
tools.best_for: Quick object and text recognition on an iPhone or Android device.

tools.name: Microsoft Translator
tools.signup: Free app or web use; no card for personal use. A Microsoft account may be optional for some features.
tools.free: Free text, camera, speech, and conversation translation across many languages, including a conversation mode for two speakers.
tools.limits: Personal free usage is subject to fair-use limits; some features, offline language packs, or larger business use may require adjustments. Translation can miss nuance and context.
tools.best_for: Cross-language conversations, travel, and understanding short written or photographed text.

tools.name: Voice Access
tools.signup: Free Play Store download; no account or card. Android only.
tools.free: A free Android accessibility service that lets you control your phone by speaking commands, with numbered labels for on-screen controls.
tools.limits: Language and Android support vary, and setup takes practice. Background noise can cause errors, and some commands or apps may not work as expected.
tools.best_for: Hands-free Android phone control when touch is difficult or uncomfortable.

tools.name: Apple Voice Control
tools.signup: Built into supported Apple devices; no account or card.
tools.free: A free built-in accessibility feature for supported Apple devices that lets you navigate and type using spoken commands.
tools.limits: Requires a supported device and setup; command availability varies by OS and app. Speech recognition can struggle with noise, accents, or unusual words.
tools.best_for: Hands-free control of an iPhone, iPad, or Mac without buying extra software.

tools.name: Windows Live Captions
tools.signup: Built into Windows 11; no account or card. Some languages need a download.
tools.free: A free built-in Windows 11 feature that automatically captions audio playing on the PC, with broader language support on newer systems.
tools.limits: Requires a compatible Windows version, may need language downloads, and does not caption every sound or app. Accuracy varies with audio quality and language.
tools.best_for: Adding on-screen captions to meetings, videos, or audio on Windows without extra software.

tools.name: Apple Live Captions
tools.signup: Built into supported Apple devices; no account or card. Beta or region limits may apply.
tools.free: A free built-in iPhone, iPad, and Mac feature that generates captions for audio from apps, calls, and conversations on supported devices.
tools.limits: Available on supported devices and languages; some features require newer hardware or are still labeled beta. Captions can lag or mishear, especially with names and jargon.
tools.best_for: On-device captions during calls, videos, and face-to-face conversations on Apple devices.

tools.name: Chrome Live Caption
tools.signup: Built into Chrome; no account or card. Some languages and devices are unsupported.
tools.free: A free, on-device Chrome feature that automatically captions audio and video played in the browser, with optional translation in some versions.
tools.limits: Language support and availability depend on Chrome version and device. Some content, DRM-protected media, or system audio may not be captioned accurately.
tools.best_for: Adding captions to web videos and browser audio without another tool.
